questions.questionText:
Select the correct alternative to indicate the arrangement of the following activities in a
logical and meaningful order.
1. Filling-in application form
2. Bank Account opened
3. Submitting necessary documents
4. Account closing
5. Depositing and withdrawing money
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (B).

questions.questionText:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming
the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts,
decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.
Statements: 
Some children are clever.
All children are honest.
Conclusions:
I. Some clever are children.
II. Some honest are children.
III. Some clever are honest.
options: Either conclusion I or III follows.
Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions II and III follow.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by Staff Selection Commission is Option (D).
